Apprentice.name: Gust
Apprentice.actions: -
Apprentice.effect:
Creates a sudden burst of wind that can push away small objects, unbalance foes, or snuff out small flames. If the target is a creature it must make a Reflex or Fortitude save. 
 Success: Target is knocked back 1 tile or knocked off-guard 1 (targets choice)
 Failure: Target is knocked back 2 tiles and knocked off-guard 2
 Critical Failure: Target is knocked back 4 tiles and knocked prone
A light object is pushed 4 tiles back. This spell cannot push large or larger creatures. You may increase the actions spent on the spell to increase the amount of tiles of knockback by 2 for each action.

Apprentice.name: Blinding Flash
Apprentice.effect:
Send a blinding flash of light at a creature. It must make a Fortitude save 
 Success: Target is dazzled for one turn.
 Failure: Target is blinded for one turn and dazzled for one minute 
 Critical Failure: Target is blinded for one minute
While affected by this spell, the target can spend one action to attempt to redo the save, removing the remaining effects on a success.

Apprentice.name: Flameshape
Apprentice.actions: -
Apprentice.effect:
Can be used to light candles, create patterns, or manipulate flames for visual effects. 
Cannot be used to deal damage directly. 
Can be cast as a Complex spell to also change the color of fire.
Apprentice.upcast: By Rank: You can control an additional fire

Adept.name: Levitate
Adept.effect:
You defy gravity and levitate the target 1 tile off the ground. When you sustain you can move the target up or down 10 feet. 
A creature floating in the air from levitate takes a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls, but can spend an Interact action to stabilize itself and negate this penalty for the remainder of its turn.
If the target is adjacent to a fixed object or terrain of suitable stability, it can move across the surface by climbing (if the surface is vertical, like a wall) or crawling (if the surface is horizontal, such as a ceiling). 
Creatures with a Glide speed have a Flight speed when affected by this spell.

Adept.name: Whirlwind
Adept.effect:
Creates a whirlwind in a 3x3 tile area. 
Creatures within the whirlwind must make a Fortitude save at the start of their turn: 
 Failure: The creature is lifted 2 tiles into the air and takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage. 
 Critical Failure: The creature is lifted 4 tiles into the air and takes 4d6 bludgeoning damage. 
When you sustain this you can move the whirlwind up to 3 tiles, carrying creatures inside the whirlwind with it.
The first time each turn you move the whirlwind into a creatures space, they must make a Fortitude save
Adept.upcast: By Rank: Increase the amount of tiles creatures are lifted by 1 and the damage by 1d6

Adept.name: Wind Wall
Adept.effect:
Creates a wall of strong wind, 10 tiles long and 3 tiles high. 
The wall blocks gaseous forms, such as clouds, and imposes a -4 penalty to ranged attack rolls passing through it. 
Small or smaller creatures attempting to move through the wall must make a Fortitude save or be pushed back 2 tiles.

Magus.name: Air Slice
Magus.effect: Send out a cutting wind, dealing 3d10 slashing damage with a basic Reflex save.
Magus.upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d10

Magus.name: Lightning Bolt
Magus.effect:
Create a bolt of lightning to strike a target in range
The target needs to make a basic Reflex save, taking 4d12 lightning damage on failure.
If the target is wearing armor made of metal or holding a metal object it makes this save with a -4 modifier, otherwise the modifier is -2.

Magus.name: Fireball
Magus.effect:
Creates a 4 tiles burst of fire at a location you can see within range.
It deals 6d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save

Magus.name: Haste
Magus.actions: -
Magus.effect:
By subtly manipulating the timestream around you can move slightly faster than normal
You are quickened 1.
If you spend 3 actions on this spell you can target an adjecant willing creature instead

GrandMagus.name: Wind Walk
GrandMagus.effect:
You select up an amount of creatures equal to 4 + your INT (or WIL if cast as an Attuned Spell). You may include yourself.
The chosen creatures gain a flight speed equal to their walking speed for the duration.
GrandMagus.upcast: By Rank: Increase the flying speed by 2

GrandMagus.name: Fiery Body
GrandMagus.effect:
Turn your body into fire. 
While sustaining this spell you cannot be grappled, restrained or have your movespeed reduced.
Any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 3d6 fire damage. 
Your unarmed melee attacks deal an extra 2d6 damage and is all fire damage.
You are immune to fire damage and effects from fire spells.
You can use a reaction to reform around a damaging attack or effect, increasing the result of a Reflex saving throw one step
You have vulnerability 10 to cold damage and damage from water spells. 
When in water or restrained by water spells you take 2d6 vital damage at the start of your turn.

Archmage.name: Pyroblast
Archmage.effect:
Sends forth a stream of superheated flame in a line.
The line is up to 10 tiles long and 1 tile wide.
Any creatures in the area need to make a Reflex saving throw or take 15d6 fire damage.
Due to supernatural heat of the spell, fire resistance is half as effective against it

Archmage.name: Sunbeam
Archmage.effect:
Create a massive illuminating beam of burning light 
The beam is a 5 tile wide and 30 tile long.
Any creatures in the line must make a Fortitude save. 
Success: Target is dazzled for one turn and takes 4d6 fire damage
Failure: Target is blinded for one turn and dazzled for one minute and takes 8d6 fire damage
Critical Failure: Target is blinded for one minute and takes 16d6 fire damage
While affected by this spell, the target can spend one action to attempt to redo the save, removing the remaining effects on a success.

Archmage.name: Tornado
Archmage.effect:
Conjure a massive swirling whirlwind that move around and pick up objects.
The tornado is 3x3 area, 20 tiles tall. 
Creatures that start their turn or enter the area of the tornade need to make a Reflex or Fortitude saving throw, taking 4d4 bludgeoning damage and being sucked up into the tornado and moved 3 tiles up on a failure.
Creatures stuck in the tornado are move with it and are off-guard 3. They can spend an action on their turn to attempt to escape, making a Athletics check against the spell. Creatures stuck in the tornado take 4d4 bludgeoning damage and are lifted 3 tiles up in the tornado at the start of their turns.
When you sustain the spell you may move the tornado up to 4 tiles.

actions.name: Quicken Spell
actions.effect: The Coatl uses its mastery of magic to cast its next spell for 1 action less. It spends 12 additional mana.

actions.name: Attune with Lair
actions.requirement: Once per minute.The Coatl is in it's designated lair which is a zone of potent mana
actions.effect: The Coatl refuels its mana and aura through an esoteric method. It regains 10d8 mana and aura.

passives.name: Coatl Venom
passives.effect: When a creature takes piercing damage from a Coatls bite they need to make Fortitude Saving Throw or take 2d8 persistent poison damage. Creatures affected by this poison they are Off-Guard 3

passives.name: Coatl Lair
passives.requirement: The Coatl is in it's  designated lair which is a zone of potent mana
passives.effect: The Coatl spends half the mana needed to casts spells.

passives.name: True Aura
passives.effect: While not Off-Guard the Coatl can always Aura Block without using a reaction
